model: stealth/ox-alpha (post-fix: temp 0.2, MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS=3, response_format: json_object, retry-on-empty)

analysis.snag_reduction: 24.3% → 6.7% (-17.6pp). The retry-on-empty fix eliminated 22 of 24 empty-response failures.
analysis.snag_detail: 2 remaining snags: one was a 30s timeout (query 10, 'International films like Everything Everywhere All at Once'), one was the retry-on-empty fallback itself producing a 25-char response (query 15, 'Movies like Stalker (1974) but newer' — retry returned too short a response).
analysis.tool_call_volume: Avg 7.3 tool calls/response (up from ~4 pre-fix). The >4 threshold flags 63.3% as over-tooling, but with >10 threshold, only 30% cross it. This is thoroughness, not confusion — 0% hallucination despite many tool calls.
analysis.cost_impact: 16 tool calls per discovery query = 16 TMDB API calls + 16 LLM round-trips per turn. At ~$0.15/call, that's ~$2.40/turn for discovery queries. With free stealth/ox-alpha, the LLM cost is $0, but TMDB API has rate limits.
analysis.conclusion: Model quality fix is successful. Actual failure rate (snag + hallucination): 40.5% → 6.7%. Tool-call volume is the remaining concern — the model is thorough but expensive. Recommend raising over-tooling threshold to >10 to match the original schema.
